method: Per genus, its POWO places that have a climate row, weighted by the number of the genus's species recorded in each. koppen = [code, share, label] from prMed + (tnMed+txMed)/2 on the 'all' variant; A-group thresholds Af>=60mm driest month, Am>=100-MAP/25, else Aw. zones = the WTE temperature x moisture domains already in climate.json, same weighting. cover = share of the genus's places that had any climate row; show=false below 0.6 because a confident profile built from a minority of the range is worse than no row (Arum: 3 of 57 places).
